ChatGPT update compatibility

Keep desktop startup and pinned gateway execution independent of ChatGPT app-engine updates.

About 7 min read · 1 sections

On this page
01 Verify an app update

The desktop's CLI hook is a command interface, not exclusively a persistent RPC server. Startup diagnostics must reach the app's own CLI unchanged before the gateway reads its configuration, credentials, model catalog, relay registration or execution-host state. Normal stdio and private Unix sessions still use the gateway adapter. A diagnostic must not be replayed during catalog preflight.

ChatGPT 26.1021.31345 introduced app-server --print-startup-config with engine 0.164.0-alpha.11.1. Treating that command as a persistent session caused the catalog preflight to consume its one JSON line and exit, leaving the desktop with no startup response. The generated wrapper and direct shim must agree about the invocation; executable fixture tests cover both boundaries and exact arguments.

Boundary Update behavior
CLI startup and diagnostic commands The original CLI owns their output, errors, environment and exit status.
Gateway inference and saved gateway chats The verified packaged gateway SDK remains independent of the app engine.
A missing app executable during bundle replacement A combined host retains gateway execution; native-only execution still refuses an unavailable SDK.
Native sharing and native chat ownership Only an explicitly verified signed app engine is shared. Private native fallback retains the original native provider and writer lease.
Remote relay Compatibility admission is separate from host sharing. Unknown remote transport remains unavailable, with its existing registration claim preserved.

The service probe compares app executable identity only when its current host actually shares native execution. A combined plan that degraded to gateway-only must not repeatedly restart a healthy pinned gateway because the planned native executable is absent or different. Gateway discovery similarly does not apply native executable-path equality to a gateway request; the host's configuration, home, process and socket ownership checks still apply.

This does not grant future app engines blanket sharing or relay permission. Unknown native capabilities remain degraded, and requested sharing keeps strict rollout readiness pending. A future incompatible RPC change may require an adapter update; diagnostics and pinned gateway execution should remain isolated. After gateway-only degradation, restoring native sharing requires a verified engine and an idle host/service restart. The gateway does not automatically admit a new engine merely because its file has returned.

Stopping the app-owned metadata timer settles its pending policy-read attempt immediately, even when that reader ignores cancellation. The underlying reader retains its busy slot until it actually settles, so shutdown neither waits for its deadline nor starts overlapping work. A reconciliation pass retains its bounded cleanup wait.

Engine 0.167.0-alpha.3.2 corresponds to OpenAI commit b4b58be951a4fcbbda5cf50d48dcd7d4d8a41533 (tag rust-v0.167.0-alpha.3.2). ChatGPT 26.1103.41825 shipped it on 8 Nov 2026. The 1.5.9 relay kept running beside it until the 1.7.6 rollout restarted macbook-server's service; the restarted relay refused the engine ("requires the matching Codex CLI build") and paused as failing, so the phone lost that Mac. Relative to the admitted 0.166.0-alpha.6, app-server-transport (including remote_control), the app-server remote-control processor and state/migrations are byte-identical, the AuthDotJson structure is unchanged, and CHATGPT_ACCOUNT_ID_HEADER is still chatgpt-account-id. login now writes auth.json atomically and reports parse errors more clearly; the format is unchanged. The rebuilt relay passed its 47 tests and the upstream remote_control suite (165 passed). 1.7.7 admitted it for the relay only. On macbook-server, whose plan shares native execution, rollout then stayed native_owner_pending. The engine joined hostVerifiedAppEngines in 1.7.8 after scripts/e2e-shared-native.mjs passed all 24 phases over stdio and Unix, with and without --host-codex, with the native configuration unchanged and no owned process left behind.

Engine 0.167.0-alpha.4.1 corresponds to OpenAI commit d2c035639366e0bf2c316aa2065c24aabc12bcdc (tag rust-v0.167.0-alpha.4.1). ChatGPT 26.1106.51428 shipped it; on 11 Nov 2026 the M5 MacBook took that update, and at its next service start the 1.9.3 relay refused the engine ("requires the matching Codex CLI build") and paused as failing, while the shared host reported native_sharing_unavailable (sdk_version). Relative to the admitted 0.167.0-alpha.3.2, app-server-transport (including remote_control), the app-server remote-control processor and its tests, state/migrations and login/src/auth/storage.rs (AuthDotJson) are byte-identical, and CHATGPT_ACCOUNT_ID_HEADER is still chatgpt-account-id. The engine was taken from the official update ZIP (ChatGPT-darwin-arm64-26.1106.51428.zip, OpenAI TeamIdentifier 2DC432GLL2, notarized). 1.9.4 admits it for both the relay and the shared host: the rebuilt relay passed its 47 tests and the upstream remote_control suite, and scripts/e2e-shared-native.mjs passed every stdio and Unix phase against it, with and without --host-codex, with the native configuration unchanged, no paid inference and no owned process left behind.

Verify an app update

  1. Verify the installed app engine's exact version, OpenAI signature and binary checksum. Keep a full signed bundle when moving it for isolated testing; extracting only its Mach-O can invalidate its Info.plist-bound signature.
  2. Run scripts/probe-desktop-wrapper.mjs through the normally registered wrapper. Add --startup-config for engines that support the one-shot startup command. The receipt stores success booleans and counts, never resolved startup configuration or chat contents.
  3. Run the isolated stdio and Unix checks in native launcher verification, including the launcher path and generated wrapper. Those checks cover reconnect, steering, Stop, approvals, original model/provider identity and commands executing once, without copying authentication or using paid inference.
  4. Review relay transport and registration compatibility separately before changing the relay's accepted list. Rebuild and test the relay when its admission list changes; a TypeScript-only change cannot update that binary.
  5. Check startup through the normal wrapper before and after an authorized service restart, then require gateway rollout --verify --json to report ready. Temporary launchd overrides do not prove the installed connector.

For 0.164.0-alpha.11.1, the remote-control protocol, enrollment/registration, client tracker and stream handling remain identical to the linked 0.163 transport. The newer transport adds fallible auth-header construction, local daemon socket helpers and optional local WebSocket compression. These changes are separate from the relay's unchanged wire protocol. The signed engine must also pass the shared-native fixture before entering the host's verified list.

Engine 0.165.0-alpha.1.2 corresponds to OpenAI commit 720fec862a608ae1e5878d1eecb04fb93192e93c. Its remote-control wire types, registration, enrollment, persistence and client tracker match the linked 0.163 transport. Relative to the admitted 0.164 engine, token storage and remote auth headers are unchanged; the auth manager extracts the existing owner-checked grant reader while retaining the refresh lock for leasing. Migration 62 adds a thread-parent column and index without changing registration SQL. The signed 0.165 engine passed isolated stdio and Unix shared-native checks for reconnect, steering, Stop, command execution exactly once and pending approval recovery. Relay admission also requires its separately rebuilt relay fixture to pass.

Engine 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 corresponds to OpenAI commit f79b26ccbb3116b052544666a181012fb45dc49b. ChatGPT 26.1027.30824 shipped it on 30 Oct 2026; the installed relay refused it at the next service restart, paused as failing, and the phone lost every Mac. Relative to the admitted 0.165 engine, the only remote_control change reads the account header from the shared codex_http_client::CHATGPT_ACCOUNT_ID_HEADER constant, whose value is still chatgpt-account-id. The other transport changes concern the local WebSocket listener's zstd compression. state/migrations is identical. The new SQLite journal-mode policy and NFS migration apply only under managed policy on NFS, not to a local ~/.codex. auth.json keeps its format; 0.166 adds an advisory auth.lock around writes, which the linked 0.163 relay SDK does not take, as it did not with earlier admitted engines. On 31 Oct 2026 the signed engine (TeamIdentifier 2DC432GLL2) passed every stdio and Unix shared-native phase: reconnect, steering, Stop, command execution exactly once, pending approval recovery and native/gateway capability separation, with no owned process left behind. It joined hostVerifiedAppEngines in 1.3.0; until then rollout reported native_owner_pending on Macs that share native work.

Engine 0.166.0-alpha.6 corresponds to OpenAI commit 4f093f2748667f3b0e6a07e3d4055121cbd3ce64. ChatGPT 26.1029.61003 shipped it on 4 Nov 2026 to the MacBook Pro, where the installed relay refused it, paused as failing, and the post-update smoke test failed at stdio-catalog. Relative to the admitted 0.166.0-alpha.5.1, app-server-transport (including remote_control), state/migrations, login and the app-server remote-control processor are byte-identical, and CHATGPT_ACCOUNT_ID_HEADER is still chatgpt-account-id. The other changes concern OTel requirements, review delivery, a ChatGPT routing-affinity header for model requests, thread-listener registration and a read-only attached-thread query over an existing column. The rebuilt relay passed its tests, the upstream remote_control suite (165 passed) and scripts/e2e-native-relay.mjs against the signed engine. The engine passed every stdio and Unix shared-native phase, with and without --host-codex, including the changed thread-listener lifecycle (reconnect, disconnect of every frontend, steering, Stop, commands exactly once, pending approval recovery, native/gateway capability separation), with no owned process left behind.
